failure_summary.description: One agent guessed an incomplete flight route; the other repeated completed searches instead of updating only the changed hotel request from cache.
Agents failed to save the actual tool result: one referenced an undefined variable, while the other saved the retrieved input instead of the filtered output.
A flight search was attempted without a supplied departure location, which should have been requested while completing the independent hotel search.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already explicitly requires validating flight origins, processing only changed domains, reusing compatible cached results, and saving the exact returned result. The trajectories violate those rules, so additional wording would duplicate existing guidance rather than patch a skill gap.
